WITH company_data AS (
  SELECT cn.id AS company_id, cn.country_code, ct.id AS company_type_id
  FROM company_name AS cn
  JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.kind = 'company'
  WHERE cn.country_code != '[us]' AND ct.note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%' AND ct.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
),
movie_info_data AS (
  SELECT mi.movie_id, it1.info AS info
  FROM movie_info AS mi
  JOIN info_type AS it1 ON it1.info IN ('Germany', 'USA', 'American')
),
movie_keyword_data AS (
  SELECT mk.movie_id, k.id AS keyword_id, k.keyword
  FROM movie_keyword AS mk
  JOIN keyword AS k ON k.keyword IN ('murder', 'murder-in-title', 'blood', 'violence')
),
western_violent_movies AS (
  SELECT t.id, MIN(t.production_year) AS production_year, MIN(cn.name) AS movie_company, MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating, t.title
  FROM title AS t
  JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = t.company_id
  JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id AND mc.company_id = cn.id AND mc.company_type_id = (SELECT id FROM company_type WHERE kind = 'production')
  JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id
  JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON mi_idx.movie_id = t.id AND mi_idx.info_type_id IN (SELECT id FROM info_type WHERE info IN ('rating', 'countries'))
  JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.kind IN ('movie', 'episode') AND kt.id = t.kind_id
  JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.movie_id = t.id AND mk.keyword_id = k.id
  WHERE t.production_year > 2008 AND mi_idx.info < (SELECT id FROM info_type WHERE info = '7.0')
  GROUP BY t.id, cn.name, mi_idx.info
),
joining AS (
  SELECT * FROM company_data
  FULL OUTER JOIN movie_info_data ON company_data.company_id = movie_info_data.movie_info_id
  FULL OUTER JOIN movie_keyword_data ON movie_info_data.movie_id = movie_keyword_data.movie_id
  FULL OUTER JOIN western_violent_movies ON joining.company_id = western_violent_movies.company_id AND joining.movie_info_id = western_violent_movies.movie_info_id
)
SELECT movie_company, rating, title AS western_violent_movie
FROM joining
WHERE company_type_id IS NOT NULL AND keyword_id IS NOT NULL
